description.nl: Romige penne met tonijn, mais en doperwten in een snelle saus van melk en belegen kaas.
description.en: Creamy penne with tuna, sweetcorn and peas in a quick sauce of milk and mature cheese.

steps.en: Cook the penne according to the packet instructions. Put the milk, 3 tbsp olive oil, the flour and the cayenne pepper in a medium-sized pan and whisk to a smooth mixture.
Slowly bring to the boil, whisking all the time so it thickens. Add the cheese, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, sweetcorn, peas, tuna and salt and pepper.
Cook the sauce for 5 minutes, stir the pasta through it and serve.

description.nl: Fusilli met stukjes zalm uit blik in een romige saus met courgette, citroenrasp en rucola.
description.en: Fusilli with flakes of tinned salmon in a creamy sauce with courgette, lemon zest and rocket.

steps.en: Drain the salmon, remove the skin and bones and break the fish into pieces. Cook the pasta in plenty of salted water until al dente.

Meanwhile, gently cook the courgettes and spring onions in the butter over a low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir in the cream cheese, crème fraîche and lemon zest, with as much water as needed for a thin sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and stir in the salmon. Drain the pasta, mix with the rocket and basil and gently fold the sauce through the pasta.
Divide the pasta between the plates and serve the cheese alongside.

name.en: Pear salad with rocket and blue cheese

description.nl: Frisse salade van peer, komkommer en rucola met blauwe kaas en walnoten, met een simpele balsamicodressing.
description.en: A fresh salad of pear, cucumber and rocket with blue cheese and walnuts, tossed in a simple balsamic dressing.

steps.en: Toss all the ingredients together. Pour the dressing over the top.

description.nl: Penne in een pittige tomatensaus met verse rode pepers, knoflook en reuzel, afgemaakt met peterselie en Parmezaan.
description.en: Penne in a fiery tomato sauce with fresh red chillies, garlic and lard, finished with parsley and Parmesan.

steps.en: Cut the lard into small cubes. Heat the oil in a casserole and fry the lard, chillies, garlic and onion over a medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring.
Add the water, the chopped tomatoes, salt and freshly ground black pepper, cover and simmer for about 40 minutes until you have a thick sauce.
Cook the penne in plenty of water with a dash of oil until al dente and drain. Add the parsley to the sauce, stir the sauce through the pasta and sprinkle with Parmesan.

description.nl: Penne in een pittige tomatensaus met ansjovis, kappertjes, olijven en salami: een stevige Siciliaanse pasta.
description.en: Penne in a spicy tomato sauce with anchovies, capers, olives and salami: a hearty Sicilian pasta.

steps.en: Cook the penne in plenty of boiling water according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large casserole and fry the oregano, chopped chilli and garlic for 10-15 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and brown sugar and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Simmer gently for 5-10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Add the anchovies, capers, olives, salami and Parmesan. Drain the penne and toss it through the sauce. Garnish with shaved Parmesan.

description.nl: Gehaktballetjes met ketjap en sambal in een romige pindasaus op basis van kokosmelk; lekker met rijst en sperziebonen.
description.en: Meatballs with kecap manis and sambal in a creamy coconut-milk peanut sauce; lovely with rice and green beans.

steps.en: In a bowl, mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, half the kecap manis and sambal, and salt and pepper to taste.
Roll into balls the size of a ping-pong ball.

Heat the oil or butter in a casserole and fry the meatballs over a medium-high heat for 10 minutes until browned all over and cooked through. Turn them regularly.
Add the onion and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and bring to the boil.
Stir in enough peanut butter to make a nicely thickened sauce.

Add kecap manis, sambal and salt and pepper to taste and gently heat the sauce through.
Delicious with rice and green beans.

name.en: Pumpkin and sun-dried tomato puff-pastry tart

description.nl: Krokante bladerdeegbodem met crème fraîche, uienchutney, spinazie, geroosterde pompoen, walnoten en geitenkaas.
description.en: A crisp puff-pastry base topped with crème fraîche, onion chutney, spinach, roasted pumpkin, walnuts and goat's cheese.

steps.en: Roast the pumpkin in the oven with balsamic vinegar, chilli oil and a little salt for about 15 minutes at 200 °C.

Lay the puff pastry sheets on a large baking tray, press them together with a fork and prick holes in them so the pastry stays flat. Spread the crème fraîche over the pastry and dot some onion chutney over it. Spread the spinach over the tray in a single layer. Scatter the pumpkin, walnuts, sun-dried tomatoes and goat's cheese over the top.
Bake the tart for about 20 minutes at 175 °C.

description.nl: Luchtige polentakoek met cheddar uit de oven, als bijgerecht bij ratatouille.
description.en: A light baked polenta with Cheddar, to serve alongside ratatouille.

steps.en: Mix the flour, polenta and cheese in a bowl. Mix the milk, butter and egg and stir into the polenta. Spoon the mixture into a greased ovenproof dish and bake for 25 minutes in the oven at 180 °C.

description.nl: Kabeljauw uit de oven onder een laagje tomaat, kaas, saffraan-ui en paneermeel, gegarneerd met citroen en olijven.
description.en: Oven-baked cod under a topping of tomato, cheese, saffron onions and breadcrumbs, garnished with lemon and olives.

steps.en: Preheat the oven to 175 °C. Heat the butter in a frying pan and gently fry the onion and garlic with the saffron for about 2 minutes. Take the pan off the heat.
Pour the juice from the tomatoes into a buttered ovenproof dish and stir in half the fried onion mixture. Lay the fish fillet on top and season with salt and pepper.
Cut the tomatoes into small pieces. Mix the cubes of cheese, the pieces of tomato, the rest of the onion mixture, the breadcrumbs and salt and pepper to taste. Spread the mixture over the fish.
Cook the fish on a rack in the middle of the preheated oven for about 25 minutes. The flesh will be white when it is done.
Garnish the dish with the lemon and, if you like, a few olives.
Serve with rice or fried potatoes and peas.

lines.raw: 150 g belegen kaas in kleine blokjes

description.nl: De klassieke hartige taart: zelfgemaakt deeg met uitgebakken spekjes, kaas en een romige eiervulling.
description.en: The classic savoury tart: homemade pastry with crispy bacon lardons, cheese and a creamy egg filling.

steps.en: Make the pastry. Sift the flour with a pinch of salt into a bowl. Add the cold butter and cut it into the flour in very small pieces (with two knives or in a food processor). Add 3-4 tbsp ice-cold water and quickly knead the dough into a cohesive ball. Leave the dough to rest, covered, in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, make the filling. Heat the butter in a frying pan and gently fry the bacon lardons until crisp. Lift the lardons out of the pan and drain them on kitchen paper. Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Beat the eggs with the cream and the bacon fat. Add salt (not too much, because of the salty bacon) and pepper to taste.

Roll the dough out into a round and line a tart tin with it. Prick a few holes in the base with a fork. Sprinkle the base with the breadcrumbs, scatter the crispy lardons and the grated cheese over it and pour the egg mixture on top.

Bake the tart on a rack in the middle of the preheated oven until cooked and golden brown, about 45 minutes. Take the tart out of the oven, let it cool slightly and then cut it into wedges. Serve the tart warm or cold with a salad.
